data.body_html:
Planning a stag weekend in Marbella and want to take the lads out on the water? You've come to the right place. This guide breaks down exactly what a marbella stag weekend yacht budget breakdown 2030 looks like — real prices, real boats, and no marketing fluff. Whether you're after a budget-friendly afternoon cruise or a full-day luxury bash with jet skis, we've got the numbers you need to plan without the stress.

All our boats depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella's glamorous superyacht marina, and every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA. No hidden fees, no surprises.

Budget Tier A: From €749 (2h) to €2,299 (8h)

If you're keeping costs sensible, Tier A boats are the sweet spot. The Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) both start at €749 for 2 hours and max out at €2,299 for 8 hours. For a group of 10, that's just €230 per person for an entire day on the water — drinks, snacks, skipper, and fuel all included.

These boats are ideal for a stag group that wants to cruise the Marbella coastline, stop for a swim at Cala del Faro, and enjoy a few beers without blowing the budget. Both depart from Puerto Banús and are available for half-day or full-day charters.

Budget Tier B: Mangusta 80 from €4,719 (4h) — Jet Ski Included

Want to impress the groom? The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) is a serious upgrade. Available in white or grey, this 24-metre express cruiser starts at €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours, and that price includes a free jet ski for the group. Perfect for stag parties who want to take turns riding while the boat is anchored off Cala Cortés or Estepona.

With space for 12 passengers, a sunpad, and a full flybridge, the Mangusta 80 is the go-to choice for a luxury stag experience without going full superyacht. For a group of 10, that's €472 per person for 4 hours — competitive for a boat of this calibre.

Other Boats: Pricing on Request

For larger groups or specific requirements, we have a fleet of other vessels — from the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) to the Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax) and the Maiora 26m (26m, 12 pax). Prices for these boats are available on request via WhatsApp, as each charter is tailored to your needs. Expect rates to be higher than Tier A and B, but with added space, luxury, and amenities.

If your stag group is smaller, consider the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) at €749 for 2 hours, or the Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) for an intimate, budget-friendly option.

What's Included in Every Charter

Every booking with us includes: licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). You don't need to bring anything except sunscreen and your good mood.

For stag groups, we can also arrange extras like a DJ/PA system, catering upgrades (paella, barbecue), or additional water toys (SUP, inflatables). Just ask via WhatsApp when booking.

Money-Saving Tips for Your Stag Weekend Yacht Charter

  • Book early: 2030 prices are fixed, but availability drops in peak season (July–August). Secure your date with a 50% deposit.
  • Go for a full day: The 8-hour Tier A charter works out cheaper per hour than two separate 4-hour bookings.
  • Share the cost: With 10-12 lads, even the Mangusta 80 becomes affordable — €472 per person for 4 hours with a jet ski.
  • Avoid peak hours: Morning departures (10:00) are often quieter and cooler than afternoon slots.
  • Bring your own playlist: Most boats have Bluetooth speakers — no need to pay extra for a DJ unless you want one.

Suggested Itinerary for a Stag Yacht Charter

A typical day on the water from Puerto Banús might look like this: depart at 10:00, cruise east past the Golden Mile and Marbella Marina, anchor for a swim and jet ski session at Cala del Faro, enjoy lunch and drinks on board, then head west towards Estepona for a final dip before returning to port by 18:00. Total distance: about 20 NM round trip, easily covered in a half-day or full-day charter.

For a longer route, push to Sotogrande or Cabo de la Plata — but that requires a full 8-hour charter.
